pre_repair.correct_control: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest --correct -q python_testcases/test_shortest_paths.py -> 3 passed in 0.01s

comparison.evidence_discipline_delta: The guided run recorded an observed symptom, alternative hypothesis, discriminating intervention, invariant, non-mutation check, and explicit root-cause classification. The baseline run gave a correct concise explanation but did not record that full causal evidence chain.
comparison.conclusion: Both runs repaired this small defect. This case does not show a repair-success advantage; it shows that the Skill made the causal and verification evidence more complete while preserving a smaller change scope.

adversarial_checks: The fixture omitted correct_python_programs and upstream Git metadata before agents ran.
Agents were allowed to change only python_programs/shortest_paths.py.
Independent verification reran public tests and checked that the public test and conftest hashes matched their pinned originals.
A hidden differential check compared two valid disconnected-component graphs against the reference implementation and asserted that candidate code did not mutate the input mapping.
An initial hidden graph with a disconnected one-way edge was rejected because the reference implementation raised KeyError; it was not scored against either candidate.

unscored_feasibility_findings.BugsInPy_tqdm_1: The immutable buggy source archive was fetched, but test collection required nose on Python 3.6.9; the current Python 3.9.6 environment had no such dependency.
unscored_feasibility_findings.Defects4J_and_Bugs_jar: No defects4j, Maven, Ant, or Gradle toolchain was available; GitHub clone transport also timed out.
unscored_feasibility_findings.Codeflaws: The repository contains only its harness; executable defects require the separate dataset archive.
unscored_feasibility_findings.BugSwarm: Its full pipeline needs dataset artifacts and an x86-64 environment, while this host is arm64.

limitations: This is one external benchmark case, not a statistically meaningful sample.
Protocol isolation is weaker than sandbox-enforced filesystem isolation.
The QuixBugs defect is intentionally small and cannot establish cross-service, migration, deployment, or production causal-analysis capability.
No external benchmark source, correct implementation, test dependency, or production system was changed.
